verdict.rationale: Lambda offers both Managed Slurm (auto-scheduling, health-managed slurmctld/slurmdbd, preinstalled HPC tooling) and Managed Kubernetes (MK8s with GPU/RDMA support, preconfigured for workload deployment), directly satisfying the need to avoid building a custom scheduler on raw nodes. Docs describe quick-start multi-node job submission and production SLAs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of Slurm/K8s scheduling behavior at scale beyond vendor docs.
